about: Synthetic HALO local-TTS benchmark lines. No customer data: names, numbers and bookings are invented. `text` is what the TTS provider receives; `ref` is what a listener should hear (STT reference; `ref_te` writes the English words in Telugu script); `critical` lists booking-critical tokens in spoken order, `|` separating accepted spellings.
